remarks: This is the perfect project to get excited about! Located in the Broad River neighborhood of Norwalk, bordering Darien, New Canaan and Silvermine. Just a hop skip to Waveny, Routes 7 and 15, and multiple local clubs. Options to enjoy as-is size wise with one level living or expand up and/or back and take advantage of the generous lot. The " good bones " in this darling little 50's ranch includes a newer roof, family room with a wood burning fireplace, hardwood floors throughout, nice bedroom sizes and two full bathrooms. The unfinished lower level has a second fireplace, newer oil fired boiler and tank and a two car garage under. This home has been kindly maintained by its original owners and is ready to become whatever you can envision. Please note - on the recorded map there are two easements shown - a town sewer line and gas line. Maps shown in photos. Buyers/contractors will have through 4/22 for due diligence. OFFER DEADLINE 5PM ON APRIL 23RD. This is an estate sale the property is being sold as-is, not subject to probate court approval.
